label: v2
info:
Production MQTT -> Supabase ingestion, running on the same Pi as the MQTT broker.

See ../README.md for the fixes applied here vs. the original export:
- "Format for Supabase" now validates the payload shape before mapping, instead of throwing
  (and silently dropping the message) on a malformed/unexpected MQTT payload.
- The HTTP response is now checked; failed inserts are logged via node.error() instead of
  disappearing into an unwired output.
- Configure a username/password on the "Local Pi Broker" node (Security tab) once the ESP32
  firmware's MQTT_USERNAME/MQTT_PASSWORD are set (see ../esp32 code/config.h) — an
  unauthenticated broker lets anything on the LAN publish or read sensor data.

"Push to Supabase" authenticates with the service_role key, which bypasses RLS — correct for
a trusted backend process like this one. Never put that key anywhere it could reach a browser.
